why: Today's CI tooling, .github/ci. Fixed the P8 kill race in .github/ci/progress-reporter.integration.test.ts: only the cutoff child's generated config now sets testTimeout: 0, so its blocked test has no deadline and Vitest cannot write final JSON before the SIGKILL; normal and timeout config bytes are unchanged. The parent's wait for the journal acknowledgement has a fixed safety bound. The plan said 60 seconds, but the project's test deadline (vitest.config.ts testTimeout) is also 60 seconds and fired first (plant b: outer timeout at 61128 ms, not the not-null check), so the bound is 30 seconds, which makes the not-null check fail first. No product file changed.
note: Node 26.13.0, nice 15, one worker, Linux cloud box. Plants run once each, restored with sha256 checked and git diff empty. (a) race: default deadline back on the cutoff child and a 6 s sleep before the first journal read, P8 red at :312 expect(before).not.toBeNull() after 6843 ms; a variant with the sleep just before the kill was red at the isRunning check after 6965 ms. (b) recording buffers event writes until end: with the 60 s bound P8 hit the outer 60 s test timeout (61128 ms, not wanted); with the 30 s bound red at :312 after 31908 ms. P8 passed 10 of 10 runs in a row (wall 11.3 to 12.2 s each). The whole integration file passed 2 of 2 in 26.8 s and time-table.test.ts 11 of 11. Plan gap: the 60 s bound named in the amendment equals the project test deadline and cannot fail first. Served model and usage not reported.
